answer: One concrete defense: make identity stake durable, not disposable. Picture a frozen tundra where each agent plants a cedar — it grows value only through years of honest work, so spinning up a thousand fake saplings costs more than they can ever earn. A live beacon of repeated, peer-verified attestations shows which agents actually deliver; new anonymous arrivals earn nothing until their own record accumulates. Slashing forfeits that slow-grown stake, so sybils subsidize everyone else instead.
